stemMd:
A performer's familiarity with a phrase can free attention for listening to other musicians. That familiarity can also become restrictive if the phrase is repeated automatically. ______, preparation supports improvisation when it remains responsive to the moment.

Which choice best completes the text?
explanationMd: The final sentence condenses the two-sided account into a conditional principle. In short signals synthesis: preparation helps when familiarity enables, rather than replaces, responsiveness.

distractorRationale.c: It synthesizes the preceding contrast rather than providing a particular instance.
distractorRationale.a: The synthesis incorporates both claims rather than simply reversing one.
